languages.name: American Sign Language

capability.headline: Research preview. Six demo words use simple movement rules. A research model holds 2,000 installed labels: 0 have been recognised at least once on unseen signers' clips, and none has yet passed SignRelay's multi-signer check.
capability.evidence: Earlier research version. On 11 previously seen, publisher-labelled development clips: 5 correct, 0 wrong, 6 no-match (PLEASE 3/3, NO 1/1, HELLO 1/3, THANK YOU 0/3, YES 0/1; SORRY untested). These results do not validate this version. Recorded-sign checks for the current word recognizer are still blocked; new signers, live cameras and non-signing movement remain untested.

languages.executionEvidence: Actual browser model execution/recovery in build-check job 125087663147; synthetic/fake-camera inputs, not signing accuracy
